page.layout: One printed page (left, page 80): running text at the top, a blank area below it framed by two horizontal rules, with the mark "PRÆ." set at the right. A second printed page is visible at the right edge, cut off by the binding; its fragments are the neighbouring page edge and are not transcribed.

main_text.p: rum controversiis plurimum deferri oportere: Secundò, & viri docti judicio & authoritati non-nihil tribuendum, ad eximendum ex animis homi-num scrupulos minus necessarios, atque etiam ad di-rigendum conscientias in rebus dubiis, de quibus non potest aliter haberi ulla certitudo. Sed de ho-rum utroque, erit fortasse posthac commodior di-cendi locus.

page.notes: The "ct" ligature in "doɛti" is transcribed as "docti" with the c in italics, which is my reading and may not match the printed form exactly. The "PRÆ." mark between the rules is uncertain in function (catchword, label or ornament-set signature); it is given as a paragraph. The right-hand page fragments (large initials and partial words such as "In", "Unu", "endu", "authe", "ximi") are cut off by the binding and are excluded as neighbouring page edge. No catchword, signature or bottom-margin text is visible.
